constraint_labels.ibravail: Inverter-based resource dispatch and curtailment balance

description: Reviewed controls that may update the active AMS optimization scenario. The LLM or UI must select from these controls; unsupported requests should be rejected gracefully.

controls.label: PQ load change
controls.description: Scale CURRENT active power p0 of an online positive PQ load device, regardless of whether its bus is PQ, PV or slack. Reactive q0 is unchanged. A bus id must be resolved through options, never guessed as a load id.

controls.label: Line outage (N-1)
controls.description: Switch one transmission line on or off to study a topology contingency.

controls.label: Generator status
controls.description: Switch one static generator on or off.

controls.label: Line rating
controls.description: Set the rate_a thermal limit of one line.

controls.label: Constraint status
controls.description: Enable or disable an existing constraint of the active routine by its exact name.

controls.label: Generator ramping limits
controls.description: Enable or disable all ramp-up, ramp-down and initial ramp constraints that actually exist in the selected AMS routine. AMS ED is multi-period and includes ramping; DCOPF has no ramping constraints.

controls.label: Additional dispatch cost
controls.description: Add coefficient * sum(pg) to the DCOPF objective. Repeated calls update this coefficient, not duplicate the term. Set zero to remove its cost effect. Incompatible with the IBR template until reset.
prompt_examples: Add an extra dispatch cost of 5 dollars per pu to the objective

controls.label: Total generation cap
controls.description: Add or update sum(pg) <= limit in DCOPF. This can make a case infeasible. Incompatible with the IBR template until reset.
prompt_examples: Add a constraint limiting total generation to 15 pu

controls.label: IBR replacement
controls.description: Replace one online conventional generator with IBR dispatch pibr and curtailment pcurt variables. Add dispatch_cost*pibr + curtailment_cost*pcurt to objective; add nonnegative bounds, availability equality and nodal balance injection. One replacement per reset; cannot combine with other structural templates.
prompt_examples: Replace PV_1 with an IBR with 1 pu available power and curtailment cost 20

unsupported_message: 当前配置暂不支持此操作，或缺少明确的目标/参数；未作任何修改。
